cards.name: Cartography Sidequest
cards.power: Weaponized FOMO - Target opponent must skip their next turn to draw cards they are not allowed to look at.
cards.lore: Go everywhere on the map. Prove to the machine that you have surveyed every inch of your own cage.
cards.gradeReason: Forcing pointless exploration is perfect anti-game satire.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: absurd quest comic. Subject: bird lost in useless map maze. Mood: obsessive completion.

cards.name: Level Goal
cards.power: Goalpost Shift - Move target opponent's victory token back three spaces.
cards.lore: Reach the end of the level. Your reward is a slightly harder level.
cards.gradeReason: Endless progression treadmill lands instantly at the table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: game satire comic. Subject: donkey chasing moving finish sign. Mood: futile progress.

cards.name: The Maze
cards.power: Cognitive Loop - Force opponent to shuffle their hand into their deck and redraw the same number minus one.
cards.lore: Find an exit to the level. Spoilers: there is no outside.
cards.gradeReason: Trapping players in loops is perfect existential mechanic.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: labyrinth comic. Subject: raccoon stuck in impossible maze. Mood: trapped confusion.

cards.name: It's All Upstairs From Here
cards.power: False Summit - Cancel an opponent's action just as it resolves.
cards.lore: Ascend to the top of a tower to fight a guy who could have just met you in the lobby.

cards.name: Run or Die
cards.power: Panic Attack - Opponent must play their next card in 3 seconds or discard it.
cards.lore: Go that way and don't stop. The illusion of choice, accelerated.
cards.gradeReason: Time pressure instantly changes table energy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: chase comic. Subject: hamster sprinting in collapsing wheel. Mood: urgent panic.

cards.name: Escape Sequence
cards.power: Scripted Collapse - Destroy all resource cards currently in play. Everyone starts running.
cards.lore: Run away from danger until you reach safety. Safety is a cutscene.
cards.gradeReason: Forced chaos movement is perfect cinematic nonsense.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: action comic. Subject: raccoon fleeing exploding corridor. Mood: chaotic escape.

cards.name: Rise to the Challenge
cards.power: Rising Sludge - Discard the bottom three cards of everyone's deck.
cards.lore: Climb up until you reach safety. Gravity is now a microtransaction.
cards.gradeReason: Funny premise, but weaker social trigger.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: surreal comic. Subject: squirrel climbing slime tower. Mood: absurd struggle.

cards.name: Broken Bridge
cards.power: Arbitrary Roadblock - Target opponent cannot attack or advance until they sacrifice a high-value card.
cards.lore: You cannot pass until the developers finish coding the next zone.
cards.gradeReason: Artificial gating is instantly recognizable and irritating.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: glitch satire comic. Subject: beaver staring at unfinished bridge. Mood: blocked progress.

cards.name: Boss Battle
cards.power: Sponge Mechanics - Absorb the next 3 attacks directed at you.
cards.lore: Defeat a challenging monster who exists solely to gatekeep your dopamine.
cards.gradeReason: Bullet sponge parody creates immediate player resentment.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: boss fight comic. Subject: obese king absorbing endless hits. Mood: unfair endurance.

cards.name: Kill Enemies to Open
cards.power: Blood Lock - Opponent cannot draw new cards until they destroy one of their own items.
cards.lore: Kill all the monsters in an area. You are the janitor of death.
cards.gradeReason: Forcing pointless violence is perfect systems satire.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: dungeon comic. Subject: badger sweeping skeleton pile. Mood: grim obligation.

cards.name: Mass Monster-Slaughter
cards.power: Grindset - Play the same low-level attack three times in a row for triple damage.
cards.lore: Kill many of the same monster. Because repetitive labor is fun when it's violent!
cards.gradeReason: Repetition as mechanic is hilariously bleak.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: grind satire comic. Subject: fox smashing identical slime enemies. Mood: repetitive chaos.

cards.name: 20 Bear Asses
cards.power: Macabre Fetch - Steal a random resource card from an opponent's hand.
cards.lore: Retrieve Random Drops for an NPC. The pinnacle of heroic fetch quests.
cards.gradeReason: Absurd quest objective instantly lands socially.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: absurd quest comic. Subject: rabbit carrying pile of bear remains. Mood: grotesque humor.

cards.name: Gotta Kill Them All
cards.power: Hitlist - Target a specific card in an opponent's deck. If drawn, it is instantly destroyed.
cards.lore: Kill everyone on a list of targets. A psychopath's grocery run.
cards.gradeReason: Obsessive hit-list turns play into stalking theater immediately.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: dark satire comic. Subject: owl pinning targets on board. Mood: manic completion.

cards.name: Kill Streak
cards.power: Momentum - For every card you played last turn, draw an extra card this turn.
cards.lore: Kill as many enemies as you can without getting hit. Perfect for your anxiety!
cards.gradeReason: Snowball ego loop rewards escalation and fuels table bravado.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: arcade satire comic. Subject: ferret stacking glowing combo counters. Mood: adrenaline rush.

cards.name: Player Versus Environment
cards.power: System Update - Change the current rules of the game randomly for one round.
cards.lore: Defeat the computer who is controlling the game against you. The house always wins.
cards.gradeReason: Rule mutation mid-play is pure Kayfabizarro destabilization.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: glitch comic. Subject: cloud boss rewriting rulebook. Mood: capricious system.

cards.name: Player Versus Player
cards.power: Divide and Conquer - Force two opponents to discard a card of each other's choosing.
cards.lore: Defeat another player who is likewise trying to defeat you. Keep the plebs fighting each other.
cards.gradeReason: Weaponized social choice guarantees arguments and alliances.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: duel satire comic. Subject: two dogs forcing choices on each other. Mood: tense rivalry.

cards.name: Escort Mission
cards.power: Suicidal AI - Attach this to an opponent. They must spend one action per turn protecting it, or lose 5 points.
cards.lore: Help a weaker ally navigate a dangerous area. The ultimate test of your patience.
cards.gradeReason: Protect-the-idiot creates instant table groans and comedy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: escort satire comic. Subject: wolf guarding clueless sheep through traps. Mood: doomed duty.

cards.name: Gotta Rescue Them All
cards.power: Guilt Trip - Opponent cannot play attack cards while you have fewer cards in your hand.
cards.lore: Save all the allies in distress. A hoarding pathology disguised as altruism.
cards.gradeReason: Strong theme, but softer immediate reaction than escort chaos.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: rescue comic. Subject: dog buried under rescued animals. Mood: overwhelmed care.

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.power: Attrition - Neither you nor your opponent can draw new cards for 2 turns.
cards.lore: Survive by not letting the enemy win. Stand in this circle until we say you can leave.
cards.gradeReason: Stalemate forces tension and table negotiation instantly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: siege comic. Subject: hedgehog defending tiny hut. Mood: stubborn defense.

cards.name: Save the Princess
cards.power: Damsel Tax - Steal an opponent's highest-value card and hide it under this card until they defeat it.
cards.lore: Rescue someone who's been kidnapped. Again. Try better locks next time.
cards.gradeReason: Recurring objective satire plus theft—clean, cruel, memorable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: fairytale satire comic. Subject: flamingo princess in cage, bored. Mood: repetitive quest.

cards.name: Fetch Quest
cards.power: Busywork - Opponent must discard two cards to draw one card.
cards.lore: Retrieve one or more Plot Coupons for an NPC. You are an intern with a sword.
cards.gradeReason: Meaningless errands translated into friction—great anti-fun engine.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: quest satire comic. Subject: wizard dog collecting pointless items. Mood: tedious grind.

cards.name: Chain of Deals
cards.power: Red Tape - Swap hands with an opponent, then randomly swap one card back.
cards.lore: Trade items for items until finally obtaining the one you want. Bureaucracy as gameplay.
cards.gradeReason: Chaotic trading creates stories and instant regret.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: barter comic. Subject: man trading items in looping arrows. Mood: slippery deals.

cards.name: Product Delivery Ordeal
cards.power: Fragile Cargo - Your next attack deals double damage, but if you take any damage before your next turn, you lose a turn.
cards.lore: Overcome obstacles to deliver Plot Coupons to an NPC. Postmates, but with dragons.
cards.gradeReason: Good pressure, but less theatrical than bigger mission swings.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: slapstick comic. Subject: pelican dropping exploding package. Mood: doomed delivery.

cards.name: Plot Coupons
cards.power: Gatekeeper - Opponent cannot play their strongest card until they play three weak cards first.
cards.lore: Collect three ancient artifacts to open the door. The narrative equivalent of a punch card.
cards.gradeReason: Arbitrary gating nails the system’s hollow progression loop.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: dungeon satire comic. Subject: raccoon hoarding glowing keys. Mood: locked progress.

cards.name: Gotta Catch Them All
cards.power: Compulsive Capture - Take control of an opponent's weakest card permanently.
cards.lore: Collect all the items or Live Items. Turning wildlife preservation into a hostage situation.
cards.gradeReason: Ownership obsession triggers instant table reactions and moral absurdity.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: parody comic. Subject: penguin hoarding creatures in jars. Mood: obsessive collection.

cards.name: Herding Mission
cards.power: Pathing Error - Opponent's cards are played on the wrong targets this turn.
cards.lore: Herd animals into an area. Because AI pathfinding is a joke we play on you.
cards.gradeReason: Miscontrol chaos creates hilarious unintended consequences.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: slapstick comic. Subject: dog failing to herd chaotic sheep. Mood: confused disorder.

cards.name: NPC Round-Up Mission
cards.power: Cat Herding - Opponent must reveal their hand and shuffle it back into their deck.
cards.lore: Gather a group of NPCs together. Wrangling digital toddlers.
cards.gradeReason: Forced regrouping disrupts plans and creates comedic reset.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: chaotic comic. Subject: cow chasing scattered chickens. Mood: frantic coordination.

cards.name: Live Items
cards.power: Inventory Bite - Discard a resource. It bites you; take 1 damage.
cards.lore: Stuffing living creatures into your infinite pocket. Don't think about the ethics.
cards.gradeReason: Inventory as horror joke is absurd and memorable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: grotesque comic. Subject: backpack monster biting owner. Mood: chaotic danger.

cards.name: Companion-Specific Sidequest
cards.power: Bribed Loyalty - Sacrifice an item card to draw two extra cards.
cards.lore: Earn your ally's favor. Friendship is transactional.
cards.gradeReason: Weaponizing relationships hits socially and thematically.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: emotional satire comic. Subject: creature offering heart tokens reluctantly. Mood: conditional trust.

cards.name: Loyalty Mission
cards.power: Trauma Dump - Opponent must skip their turn to listen to your backstory.
cards.lore: Complete your ally's personal goal so they don't betray you at the finale.
cards.gradeReason: Forcing emotional labor is peak Kayfabizarro discomfort.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: therapy satire comic. Subject: animal ranting while others trapped listening. Mood: exhausting confession.

cards.name: Romance Sidequest
cards.power: Simulated Love - Force an opponent's card to fight for you for one round.
cards.lore: Earn your ally's love. Select dialogue option C to receive affection.
cards.gradeReason: Romance as control mechanic is hilarious and slightly sinister.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: romance parody comic. Subject: peacock seducing blank mannequin. Mood: artificial affection.

cards.name: Cosmetic Award
cards.power: Shiny Distraction - Negate all damage this turn, but your cards look absolutely ridiculous.
cards.lore: A shiny hat to validate your hundred hours of meaningless grinding.
cards.gradeReason: Vanity reward as defense is perfect meta-commentary.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: fashion satire comic. Subject: bear in ridiculous armor posing. Mood: hollow pride.

cards.name: Stock Video Game Puzzle
cards.power: Sliding Blocks - Rearrange the order of the top 5 cards of any deck.
cards.lore: Solve a puzzle. Because the ancient architect loved pushing ice blocks around.
cards.gradeReason: Recognizable trope but less socially explosive.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: puzzle comic. Subject: tiger moving colored blocks. Mood: methodical frustration.

cards.name: Mini-Game
cards.power: Distraction Game - Both players must roll a die; highest roll steals a card from the lowest.
cards.lore: Play a smaller game with its own rules. Pacing is a myth.
cards.gradeReason: Nested games create delightful chaos and derail momentum.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: arcade comic. Subject: dragon playing tiny arcade cabinet. Mood: chaotic diversion.

cards.name: Variable Player Goals
cards.power: Goal Fragmentation - Change the win condition of the game for 2 turns.
cards.lore: Why save the world when you could be taking photos of frogs?
cards.gradeReason: Temporary win-condition shift is pure system destabilization.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: absurd comic. Subject: monkeys boating with cameras ignoring quest. Mood: distracted purpose.

cards.name: Instant-Win Condition
cards.power: Deus Ex Machina - If you hold this card for 5 consecutive turns without playing it, you win the game.
cards.lore: Reaching the most important objective. Press X to end the simulation.
cards.gradeReason: Arbitrary victory condition perfectly mocks game logic.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: surreal comic. Subject: sleeping creature beside red button. Mood: anticlimactic power.

cards.name: 100% Completion
cards.power: Sunk Cost Fallacy - Opponent cannot win unless their hand is completely empty.
cards.lore: Don't miss any optional objectives. Your digital grave requires all the shiny trinkets.

cards.name: Gameplay Grading
cards.power: Harsh Grading - If opponent's attack doesn't defeat a card instantly, the attack is negated.
cards.lore: Play the game as well as possible. The machine judges your worth.

cards.name: Secret Ending
cards.power: Lore Dump - Reveal your entire hand to the opponent; if you have a pair, double your attack points.
cards.lore: Collect all 500 hidden rocks to learn the true, disappointing lore.

cards.name: Bragging Rights Reward
cards.power: Hollow Victory - Gain 10 points, but you cannot attack on your next turn.
cards.lore: An achievement for your profile that literally nobody else cares about.

cards.name: Challenge Run
cards.power: Self-Sabotage - Play with your hand facing outward to the opponent, but your attacks do +2 damage.
cards.lore: Complete the game with optional restrictions. Because normal misery wasn't enough.

cards.name: Self-Imposed Challenge
cards.power: Blindfolded - Draw cards blindly from the bottom of your deck.
cards.lore: Completes the game with your own restrictions. Stockholm Syndrome: Expert Edition.

cards.name: No Item Use for You
cards.power: Elixir Hoarder - Opponent cannot use item cards for 3 turns.
cards.lore: Don't use your items. Hoard the mega-elixirs until the credits roll.

cards.name: No-Gear Level
cards.power: Confiscated Inventory - All players must discard their currently equipped items.
cards.lore: Don't use weapons or equipment. A sudden, arbitrary strip search by the developers.

cards.name: Speedrun
cards.power: Sequence Break - Skip your opponent's next turn.
cards.lore: Complete objectives as quickly as possible. Skip the story, break the physics.

cards.name: Stealth-Based Mission
cards.power: Instant Fail - If opponent plays a loud (attack) card, their turn instantly ends.
cards.lore: Don't let enemies notice you. An instant fail state for stepping on a twig.

cards.name: Timed Mission
cards.power: Ticking Clock - Opponent has exactly 10 seconds to complete their entire turn.
cards.lore: Complete objectives before time runs out. Artificial stress for artificial stakes.

cards.name: No-Damage Run
cards.power: Glass Cannon - If you take any damage, discard your entire hand.
cards.lore: Don't get hurt. One microscopic pixel of a hitbox ruins five hours of work.

cards.name: The Cake is a Lie
cards.power: Bait and Switch - Play a card face down. When opponent attacks it, it explodes for 3 damage.
cards.lore: Your real goal is to destroy the facility. The reward was bait.

cards.name: Princess in Another Castle
cards.power: Moved Goalpost - Move an opponent's target to a different card just as they attack.
cards.lore: Finding and saving the princess. Except your reward is a fungal hallucination.

cards.name: Collect 12 Logs
cards.power: Tunnel Vision - Opponent can only play resource cards this turn; no attacks.
cards.lore: Goals players become too dependent on, forgetting how to actually play.

cards.name: 100 Babies
cards.power: Swarm Mechanics - Fill your opponent's hand with useless 0-point cards.
cards.lore: Players can set their own goals, such as having 100 babies. You are the architect of your own hell.

cards.name: Scoring Points
cards.power: High Score - Gain 100 meaningless points. They do nothing, but you feel great.
cards.lore: Completing an objective to watch a digital integer increase. Dopamine achieved.

cards.name: Experience Grind
cards.power: Level Up - Discard 5 cards to increase your base attack by 1.
cards.lore: Repeat the same action until the bar is full. Welcome to middle management.

cards.name: Gold Sink
cards.power: Inflation - All cards cost double to play this turn.
cards.lore: A mechanic designed purely to delete the wealth you spent 40 hours accumulating.

cards.name: Hero Must Survive
cards.power: Game Over - Flip the table. (Or, in gameplay: End the match immediately [Rest vom GW-Logo verdeckt])
cards.lore: Don't allow a specific character to be killed. Good thing you're not the hero.

qa.verdict: This deck absolutely nails system critique by turning videogame design patterns into ritual traps. The strongest cards—Escort Mission, Player Versus Environment, Speedrun—don’t simulate mechanics, they expose them. Every action feels like you’re being played by the system itself. That’s the joke, and it lands. Table-ready? Completely. Expect frustration, laughter, and existential clarity.

urgent: Minor OCR smoothing on a few quest descriptions for clarity
quickWins: Tighten weaker mid-tier quest cards to trigger stronger table reactions
niceToHave: Icon consistency pass for mission categories

notes: Cover page is decorative only. This deck functions as a critique of game design loops and artificial progression systems. Best played with emphasis on frustration, timing pressure, and rule instability.
marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: MISSION CONTROL – Your Gaming Trauma, Weaponized Against Your Friends (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

Every game you ever "beat" was a part-time job you volunteered for, unpaid, on a schedule someone else set.

You think you played the game. The loop played you. Modern design runs on manufactured scarcity and engineered frustration: the fetch quest that pads the runtime, the escort mission built so the AI walks into the fire, the daily login timed to colonize the one hour you had left. You called it fun because the lighting was good and the music swelled on cue. It was a treadmill with a progress bar.

This is Social Story Wrestling pointed straight at the controller. 56 cut-and-play cards where every cheap trick, grind, and broken promise becomes a character you perform out loud, while the table decides whether you sold the bit or got booed back to the title screen.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The Mission Control Core Deck: 56 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" Cards, featuring No-Damage Run (the flex nobody asked you to prove), Fetch Quest (walk there, walk back, call it content), and 20 Bear Asses (kill ten bears, loot drops on eight, welcome to the math of the grind).
- The Freestyle Rules: The complete Anti-Rulebook. No spreadsheets, no XP tables, just storytelling, dice-driven chaos, and a Rule-Instability clause that lets the table rewrite the win condition mid-match, exactly like the patch notes you never read.
- The Grind Engine: turn fake progression into the actual game. Stack Escort Missions, put the table on a Speedrun clock, and watch artificial difficulty reveal itself as the product it always was.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I make these cards for people who'd rather laugh at the machine than keep feeding it quarters. Broke? Enter "0" and take it. Play it. Make a friend perform a Fetch Quest in real time. Want to support the craft? Every dollar goes into the next deck instead of a loot box.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
"You don't beat the loop. You quit it out loud, at a table, with witnesses."
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
